source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Απολλώνιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The day's bare line is told apart by the page behind it, which gives him a see: bishop of Brescia in Italy, martyred in the second century. The corpus keeps a `theophilus-of-brescia` on 27 April but no bishop Apollonius of that city, and its four other men of the name — of Sardis, the Anchorite, the Reader and the companion of Proclus — are on other days; so is the Apollonius of 6 July, burned in a ship at sea, drafted in the same wave. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
